scenario: I purposely ignored a coworker's repeated requests for help with a task I was responsible for assisting with, even though I was available.
sentences: The assistance was viewed as being respected by the team because the requests for help were acknowledged by the coworker.
The task was left uncompleted by the colleague in need because the responsibility was neglected by the assigned person.
The teamwork was considered to be encouraged by management because the support was offered by the workplace.
The expectation was met by the work process because the coworker was available to assist.
